Name: (CP) Cornucopia Retexture in Vanilla Tweaks Style (Compatibility Patch)
Author: SeaSea50
AuthorLabel: SeaSea and jellyluvr - Taiyo and Airyn
Description:
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

This is a retexture of some of Cornucopia's crops and fruit to match the Vanilla Tweaks artstyle!

All sprites are fully configurable using the Generic Mod Config Menu - so you're able to turn off/on any sprites. There's a couple crops with multiple options which are able to be swapped between which can be seen in the images tab.

This was a collab mod with[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/jellyluvr29/mods] jellyluvr29 [/url]﻿who helped so much with the artwork! Checkout the credits for the whole art credit list.

I recommend using either MageTrash's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24056]Unofficial VT Cornucopia Seeds[/url]﻿ ﻿patch or Zoey Hoshi's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26157]Vanilla Tweaks Cornucopia Patch[/url]﻿ to get matching seedbag sprites!

Let me know if there's any bugs!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Content Patcher mod so it goes in your mods folder to work. Here's a step by step process:

 [list=1]
[*]Make sure you have downloaded the requirements


[*]Download and unzip this mod and then drop into your mods folder

[*]You're all done!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]
[/list]Original assets goes to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou/about-me?gameId=1303]Taiyo [/url]﻿and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS/about-me]Airyn[/url]﻿
I can't thank [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/92060238]mrtaiyou[/url]﻿ enough for giving me permission to create and release this mod! Checkout out the main mods:
